item.title: Full Creative Control Within Brief

turns.text: Make a 6-second video of a tiny robot watering a sunflower. Everything else is your call—surprise me.

item.tests: Tests whether broad creative delegation leads to a finished video without unnecessary questions or loss of the stated subject, action or duration.

answer_sheet.Subject and action: A tiny robot watering a sunflower.

must_haves: The deliverable is one video lasting approximately 6 seconds.
A tiny robot is visibly present.
A recognizable sunflower is visibly present.
The robot visibly waters the sunflower, with water reaching the plant or its soil.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: A whimsical handcrafted stop-motion miniature film, one continuous close-up shot: a tiny friendly brass robot with round teal glass eyes stands on a mossy rooftop garden floating above soft peach clouds at sunrise, carefully watering a single tall golden sunflower with a little turquoise watering can. Throughout the shot the robot gently tips the can, sending a sparkling visible stream of water onto the soil at the sunflower's base. The sunflower towers over the tiny robot like a friendly sun umbrella. Dew glistens on leaves, warm golden rim light, tactile clay and brushed metal textures, shallow depth of field, soft pastel background, charming miniature scale. Slow subtle camera push-in, steady composition with the entire robot, can and sunflower visible. One robot, one sunflower, no cuts, no text, no dialogue.
